errors.text_span: За всеки регион са изобразени шест стълба
errors.evidence: The description states that there are six bars for each region, but the chart shows only five bars per region, corresponding to the years 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
The description states that the legend is in the top right corner, but it is located in the bottom right corner of the chart.
The description of the vertical axis fails to mention that it is explicitly labeled with the currency unit 'лв.'.

errors.text_span: Визуално се наблюдава разнообразие в стойностите на линията на бедността между регионите и през годините, като в някои региони стойностите са по-високи, а в други – по-ниски, при различни трендове по време на периода.
errors.evidence: This sentence is too generic and simply states that values are different across regions and years. It fails to mention any specific trends, such as the general increase over time for most regions or that the national average is consistently the highest.
The phrase 'всеки групирани стълба' is grammatically awkward in Bulgarian. A more correct phrasing would be 'всяка група стълбове'.
